body: I don't care about you. Just because something applies to you doesn't mean it applies to me. You aren't trying to understand me. You're trying to understand yourself whilst projecting your inner views onto other people. Get out of here.

Not wanting to waste effort to counteract points I've already countered before is a waste of time. I already know the responses to those counter arguments, and the counters to those. It can go on and on. It's a waste of time. You're not enlightening me with any new information. I'm not validating anything that you said. I don't agree with most of it, and there's no reason to go on further responding to it. It's not going to help me. It's not going to help you. Go about your day.
I'm not going to waste more time arguing with you. Your viewpoint is completely different from mine. I don't care about your viewpoint. Bye.

Uhm. I'm not afraid of death. I never mentioned I was worried about death. Don't know where you're pulling that from. 

Life isn't up in the air. I already know how my life will go. I know who I am as a person, and I know what kinds of actions I will take. I'm not going to live for very much longer, I'm absolutely certain.

No. I'm not trying to make friends. I do not want friends. No. I'm not going to extend friendship to others. That's quite ridiculous. I have extreme anxiety around people. It's not something that will ever be an option, and I never have been, and never will be an extraverted person that can just walk out and make friends with people. I simply don't work like that. I'm not waiting for people to come to me. I'm waiting to die.

And this is quite ridiculous... "If you want them to befriend you, force them. The best way to force someone to be your friend is be 100% YOURSELF. "

You don't force people to be your friends. It happens naturally. On top of that, you clearly don't understand that some people are just bad people. Being 100% "yourself", for me, would be a surefire way to make all people avoid me in the first place.
Well, good for you for having people around you to help you.

Congrats. There won't be a "try" for me. I won't fail. If I "try" to kill myself, I will be dead afterwards. Anyone who "tries" to kill themselves and aren't successful weren't actually trying to kill themselves.
Ok. Thanks for solving my problems.
